title: Go And Give Items To Owner Behavior
description: The entity will attempt to toss the items from its inventory to its owner.

on_item_throw.title: Item Throw
on_item_throw.description:
Event(s) to run when this mob throws items.

Sample values:
• allay: [{"event":"pickup_item_delay","target":"self"}]

reach_mob_distance.title: Reach Mob Distance
reach_mob_distance.description: Sets the desired distance to be reached before giving items to owner.

run_speed.title: Run Speed
run_speed.description:
Sets the entity's speed when running toward the owner.

Sample values:
• allay: 8

throw_sound.title: Throw Sound
throw_sound.description:
Sound to play when this mob throws an item.

Sample values:
• allay: item_thrown

vertical_throw_mul.title: Vertical Throw Mul
vertical_throw_mul.description: Sets the vertical throw multiplier that is applied on top of the throw force in the vertical direction.

priority.title: Priority
priority.description: As priority approaches 0, the priority is increased. The higher the priority, the sooner this behavior will be executed as a goal.
